meta_title: US Passport Photo Size (2×2 in) & Requirements | Resize-It
meta_description: US passport photos are 2 × 2 in (51 × 51 mm) with a 1–1⅜ in head on a white or off-white background, taken in the last 6 months, no glasses. Check the rules and crop yours.
h1: US Passport Photo Size and Requirements
subtitle: Crop your photo to 2 × 2 inches and print a sheet, checked against the U.S. Department of State photo rules.

tool_workspace.description: Upload a photo to crop it to the official size. Everything is processed in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

requirements.notes_h3: Tips from the State Department guidance

rows.label: Head size
rows.value: 1–1⅜ inches (25–35 mm) from the bottom of your chin to the top of your head

rows.label: Background
rows.value: Plain white or off-white, with no shadows, texture, lines or objects

rows.label: Glasses
rows.value: Remove them, along with anything else covering your face, unless for documented religious or medical reasons

rows.label: Editing
rows.value: No filters or retouching that change your appearance

rows.label: Online renewal upload
rows.value: JPG, JPEG, PNG, HEIC or HEIF, between 54 KB and 10 MB, high resolution and not blurry or pixelated

notes: Stand several feet in front of a white or off-white wall. If your wall is not white, cover it with a white sheet.
Renewing online? Upload the original, uncropped photo. The State Department asks for an original image for online renewal.
If your photo cannot meet the online requirements, you may need to renew by mail instead.
Print the PDF sheet at 100% (no "fit to page") so each photo is exactly 2 × 2 inches.

sources.label: U.S. Department of State: Passport photos

requirements.checked: Checked against these sources in November 2026. Rules change, so confirm on the official page before you apply.

how_to.title: How to make a US passport photo
how_to.step1_text: Stand in front of a plain background in even light and have someone else take the photo at eye level. Follow the US rules below.
how_to.step2_text: Choose the photo. It is processed in your browser and never uploaded to a server.
how_to.step3_text: Drag the frame to centre your face and use Zoom until your head fills the frame to the size the rules require.
how_to.step4_text: Download the PDF sheet and print it at actual size (100%, no "fit to page") on photo paper, then cut out the photos.

items.q: What size is a US passport photo?
items.a: 2 × 2 inches (51 × 51 mm). Your head must measure 1 to 1⅜ inches (25–35 mm) from the bottom of your chin to the top of your head.

items.q: Can I wear glasses in a US passport photo?
items.a: No. Remove glasses and anything else covering your face unless you wear it for documented religious or medical reasons.

items.q: What background does a US passport photo need?
items.a: Plain white or off-white, with no shadows, texture, lines or objects.

items.q: What file can I upload for online renewal?
items.a: A JPG, JPEG, PNG, HEIC or HEIF file between 54 KB and 10 MB that is high resolution and not blurry. Upload the original photo rather than a cropped one.
